reverse_hunks.current:
use_secondary_drive_vm:
        description: Run the exact 429 rehearsal on the isolated secondary-drive VM
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

if: >-
      ${{ !inputs.use_secondary_drive_vm ||
      (github.repository == 'lasrevinu333-design/memphis-zoo-mcp' &&
       github.actor == 'lasrevinu333-design' && github.triggering_actor == github.actor &&
       github.ref == 'refs/heads/codex/custodial-429-rehearsal-preparation' &&
       github.run_attempt == '1' && inputs.backup_run_id == '45645963579' &&
       inputs.current429_candidate_commit == github.sha && inputs.rehearsal_scope == 'backup_only' &&
       inputs.official_local_storage_provider && inputs.private_current429_forward_capture &&
       !inputs.private_current428_forward_capture && !inputs.private_context_cost_diagnostic_only) }}
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.use_secondary_drive_vm && 'custodial-foundation-isolated' || 'ubuntu-24.04' }}
    timeout-minutes: ${{ inputs.use_secondary_drive_vm && 1140 || (inputs.rehearsal_scope == 'backup_only' && inputs.official_local_storage_provider && !inputs.private_context_cost_diagnostic_only && 350 || 45) }}

if test "$PRIVATE_REHEARSAL_SECONDARY_VM" = true; then
            test "$PRIVATE_CURRENT429_FORWARD_CAPTURE" = true
            test "$private_route_active" = true
            test "$GITHUB_ACTOR" = lasrevinu333-design
            test "$GITHUB_REF" = refs/heads/codex/custodial-429-rehearsal-preparation
            source scripts/current429-vm-scratch.sh
          else
            test -n "$REHEARSAL_CUSTODIAL_BACKEND_PROOF_SECRET"
            test -n "$REHEARSAL_CUSTODIAL_NATIVE_ROUTE_PROOF_SECRET"
            test -n "$REHEARSAL_DEVICE_CREDENTIAL_SECRET"
            test -n "$REHEARSAL_OPS_MANAGER_SESSION_SECRET"
          fi

if test "$PRIVATE_REHEARSAL_SECONDARY_VM" = true; then
              if test "$RUNNER_TEMP" != "$receipt_root"; then
                for name in production-backup-migration-rehearsal.jsonl private-backup-only-rehearsal.json official-local-storage-provider-evidence; do
                  if test -e "$RUNNER_TEMP/$name"; then cp -PR -- "$RUNNER_TEMP/$name" "$receipt_root/" || status=1; fi
                done
              fi
              if close_current429_vm_scratch; then
                printf '{"encrypted_scratch_closed":true,"runner_restored":true}\n' > "$receipt_root/current429-vm-cleanup.json"
              else
                printf '%s\n' 'The rehearsal VM scratch cleanup was not verified.' >&2
                status=1
              fi
              trap - EXIT
              exit "$status"
            fi

if test "$PRIVATE_REHEARSAL_SECONDARY_VM" = true; then
            open_current429_vm_scratch
            printf '%s\n' 'Verified encrypted scratch and Docker data on the VM secondary drive.'
          fi
          backup_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/production-backup"
          receipt="${RUNNER_TEMP}/production-backup-migration-rehearsal.jsonl"
          postgres_log="${RUNNER_TEMP}/production-backup-migration-rehearsal-postgres.log"

sign_current429_vm:
    needs: rehearse
    if: inputs.use_secondary_drive_vm
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: '22.23.4'
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: vm-unsigned-backup-rehearsal-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/current429-vm-receipt
      - name: Verify the VM receipt and sign on the hosted runner
        env:
          RELEASE_REHEARSAL_ATTESTATION_SIGNING_KEY: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_REHEARSAL_ATTESTATION_SIGNING_KEY }}
          RELEASE_REHEARSAL_ATTESTATION_SIGNING_KEY_ID: ${{ vars.RELEASE_REHEARSAL_ATTESTATION_SIGNING_KEY_ID }}
          RELEASE_MIGRATION_REHEARSAL_RECEIPT: ${{ runner.temp }}/current429-vm-receipt/production-backup-migration-rehearsal.jsonl
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          receipt_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/current429-vm-receipt"
          jq -e '. == {encrypted_scratch_closed:true,runner_restored:true}' "$receipt_dir/current429-vm-cleanup.json" >/dev/null
          node scripts/verify-current429-rehearsal.mjs
          npm run --silent release:migrations:attest-rehearsal > "$receipt_dir/production-backup-migration-rehearsal-attestation.json"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: production-backup-migration-rehearsal-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/current429-vm-receipt/production-backup-migration-rehearsal.jsonl
            ${{ runner.temp }}/current429-vm-receipt/production-backup-migration-rehearsal-attestation.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/current429-vm-receipt/current429-vm-cleanup.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

needs: [rehearse, sign_current429_vm]
    if: >-
      ${{ !cancelled() && needs.rehearse.result == 'success' &&
      (!inputs.use_secondary_drive_vm || needs.sign_current429_vm.result == 'success') &&
      inputs.private_current429_forward_capture && inputs.deploy_current429_if_verified }}

assert.ok(lifetimeMs===60*60*1000 || lifetimeMs===6*60*60*1000 ||
    (lifetimeMs===secondaryVmIntentMs && binding.archive_digest===current429.archiveDigest),'Closed disposable rehearsal intent lifetime required');
reverse_hunks.previous: assert.ok(lifetimeMs===60*60*1000 || lifetimeMs===6*60*60*1000,'Closed disposable rehearsal intent lifetime required');
